messages.subject: matrixInput with other controls
parts:
I have gotten matrixInput from shinyIncubator to work.
HOWEVER, it seems to break other controls.
Below is an example with a matrixInput and sliderInput...

server.r:
library(shiny) 
shinyServer(function(input, output) {  output$print <- renderPrint({
  print(input$enrollrates)})}) 


ui.r
library(shinyIncubator) 
shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(  
  headerPanel(title='Matrix and slider input',windowTitle="inputMatrix"),  
  sidebarPanel(
    matrixInput(inputId="enrollRates",
      label="Enrollment rates and duration",
      data=data.frame("Rate"=1,"Duration"=12)),
    sliderInput(inputId="x",label="Slider",min=0,max=1,value=.5,step=.01)
  ),    
  mainPanel("Main panel")))
